# truenas_snapshot (Data Source)

Fetches information about a TrueNAS ZFS snapshot.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Snapshot identifier in the form "dataset@name" (e.g. tank/mydata@snap1).

### Read-Only

- `createtxg` (String)
- `dataset` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `pool` (String)
